title: Hamster dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='fur' cx='50%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd27a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a24a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- dancing motion lines -->
  <path d='M18 30 Q12 34 16 40' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M82 30 Q88 34 84 40' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 62 Q13 66 18 72' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 62 Q87 66 82 72' stroke='#7fd4ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <path d='M31 56 Q22 44 20 30' stroke='#e8a24a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='28' r='5' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <!-- right arm up -->
  <path d='M69 56 Q78 44 80 30' stroke='#e8a24a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='28' r='5' fill='#ffd27a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='20' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#fff2d6'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffb3c7'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffb3c7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='21' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='19' r='7' fill='#e8a24a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='19' r='4' fill='#ffb3c7'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='19' r='7' fill='#e8a24a'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='19' r='4' fill='#ffb3c7'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='43' r='5' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='43' r='5' fill='#ff9db5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='34' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='32.5' r='1.3' fill='#8ff5ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32.5' r='1.3' fill='#8ff5ff'/>
  <!-- nose and smile -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ff6f91'/>
  <path d='M45 45 Q50 49 55 45' stroke='#b06a2a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M30 40 L20 38' stroke='#fff2d6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 44 L20 45' stroke='#fff2d6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 40 L80 38' stroke='#fff2d6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 44 L80 45' stroke='#fff2d6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
